name: FLEX
title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment
keywords: droplet diffusion flames; fire suppressants CO2/He/SF6; extinction; sooting; cool flames
objective: Map flammability limits of liquid fuels in microgravity, measure effectiveness of gaseous suppressants (CO2, He, SF6), and build predictive combustion-limit models (burning rates, extinction, radiation, soot).

name: FLEX-2
title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment - 2
keywords: decane; radiative & diffusive extinction; multi-droplet arrays; ethanol; soot formation
objective: Extend FLEX-1 to realistic fuels/conditions; benchmark bi-component droplet combustion (liquid-phase mixing, extinction mechanisms, droplet arrays, convective flow).

name: CFI
title: Cool Flames Investigation
keywords: n-dodecane; iso-dodecane; farnesane; helium dilution; NTC low-temperature chemistry; extinction
objective: Cool-flame behaviour of n-dodecane and blends at 0.25-5 atm, helium dilution effects, droplet size/pressure vs extinction, and soot during cool-flame combustion.

name: BASS
title: Burning and Suppression of Solids
keywords: flame spread; fire suppression; Damkohler number; forced flow; fabrics, PMMA, SIBAL
objective: Bridge NASA-STD-6001 Test 1 and real microgravity flammability using realistic thick fuels; assess inert gaseous extinguishing agent effectiveness.

name: BASS-II
title: Burning and Suppression of Solids - II
keywords: flame spread; extinction limits; low-velocity forced flow; PMMA; fire suppression
objective: Ignition, growth, spread and extinction limits of solid fuels in low-speed forced flow; links to NASA-STD-6001; preliminary data for SoFIE.

name: SAFFIRE-I
title: Spacecraft Fire Safety Experiment-I
keywords: large-scale fire growth; SIBAL fabric; concurrent flow; flammability limits
objective: How rapidly a large-scale fire grows in low gravity and how low-g flammability limits compare with the 1-g NASA screening test.

name: SAFFIRE-II
title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment-II
keywords: silicone, Nomex, SIBAL, PMMA samples; smoldering; smoke distribution
objective: Large-scale fire growth rate and low-g flammability limits of 9 spacecraft materials vs the 1-g screening test.

name: SAFFIRE-III
title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment-III
keywords: large-scale flame spread; SIBAL; low-gravity fire testing
objective: Large-scale fire growth and low-g flammability limits (repeat of Saffire-I with new conditions).

name: SAME
title: Smoke and Aerosol Measurement Experiment
keywords: smoke particle size; Teflon, Kapton, silicone, cotton, DBP; smoke detector design
objective: Quantify low-g smoke particle sizes vs smoke generation/transport conditions to inform spacecraft smoke detectors.

name: SAME-R
title: Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment-Reflight
keywords: smoke; TEM grids; thermal precipitators; Kapton, Pyrell, Teflon, silicone, cotton
objective: Reflight of SAME with improved thermal precipitators to measure smoke droplet size distributions in low gravity.

name: DAFT / DAFT-2
title: Dust and Aerosol Measurement Feasibility Test 1 & 2
keywords: P-Trak condensation nuclei counter; DustTrak; aerosol measurement in microgravity
objective: Show a modified P-Trak particle counter works in microgravity (risk reduction for SAME).

name: SPICE
title: Smoke Point In Co-flow Experiment
keywords: smoke point; soot emissions; laminar coflow diffusion flames; ethylene, propane
objective: Laminar smoke-point properties of non-buoyant jet flames vs coflow, burner diameter and fuel; sooting propensity.

name: SLICE
title: Structure and Liftoff In Combustion Experiment
keywords: lifted diffusion flames; fuel dilution; inlet velocity; flame stability
objective: Structure and stability of laminar diffusion flames in microgravity; liftoff limits; dilution effect on soot and stability.

name: ACME BRE
title: ACME - Burning Rate Emulator
keywords: burning rate; heat flux; radiative extinction; spacecraft atmospheres (14.7 psia/21% O2 ... 8.2 psia/34% O2)
objective: Emulate burning of condensed fuels with gaseous fuels on porous burners to relate flammability to material properties in spacecraft atmospheres.

name: ACME CLD Flame
title: ACME - Coflow Laminar Diffusion Flame
keywords: coflow flames; methane, ethylene; lift-off; soot volume fraction; extinction limits
objective: Characterize weak and sooty coflow diffusion flames vs velocity and fuel dilution (shape, lift-off, temperature, extinction, soot).

name: ACME E-FIELD Flames
title: ACME - Electric-Field Effects on Laminar Diffusion Flames
keywords: ion-driven wind; chemi-ionization; electric field; soot; lifted flames
objective: Relationship between electric-field voltage and ion current, dynamic flame response, soot formation and near-limit lifted flames.

name: ACME s-Flame
title: ACME - Structure and Response of Spherical Diffusion Flames
keywords: spherical diffusion flames; H2/CH4/C2H4; radiative & kinetic extinction; flame structure
objective: Transient structure and quasi-steady extinction limits of spherical diffusion flames for model validation.

name: ACME Flame Design
title: ACME - Flame Design
keywords: soot inception; normal & inverse spherical flames; stoichiometric mixture fraction; radiative extinction
objective: Soot-inception limits and extinction of normal/inverse spherical flames vs flow, Zst, diluent and pressure (design of soot-free flames).

name: ACME CFI-G
title: ACME - Cool Flames Investigation with Gases
keywords: cool diffusion flames; ethane, propane, n-butane; low-temperature chemistry
objective: Conditions for cool diffusion flames of gaseous fuels (normal & inverse) and validated kinetics via CFD.

name: Effect of External Thermo-Convective Perturbation on Cool Flame Dynamics (CFD)
title: Effect of External Thermo-Convective Perturbation on Cool Flame Dynamics (CFD)
keywords: cool flames; droplet drift; OpenFOAM 3-D CFD; extinction diameter
objective: Quantify how heating and drift-induced convection change droplet cool-flame dynamics; stability maps from CFD validated on FLEX.

name: Quantitative Studies of Cool Flame Transitions at Radiation/Stretch Extinction Using Counterflow Flames
title: Quantitative Studies of Cool Flame Transitions at Radiation/Stretch Extinction Using Counterflow Flames
keywords: cool flame flammability limits; ozone-assisted counterflow; radiation extinction
objective: Flammability/extinction diagram for diffusional cool flames using FLEX data plus counterflow experiments and modelling.

name: Utilization of SAME Data for Modeling of Smoke Generation in Micro-Gravity
title: Utilization of SAME Data for Modeling of Smoke Generation in Micro-Gravity
keywords: smoke nanoparticle growth; thermophoresis; Earth vs microgravity simulations
objective: Numerical simulation of gravity's influence on pyrolysis smoke growth (1-g vs 0-g).

name: Concurrent Flame Spread Modeling using Flamelet Generated Manifolds vs BASS
title: Concurrent Flame Spread Modeling using Flamelet Generated Manifolds vs BASS
keywords: flame spread modeling; FGM; two-color tomography
objective: Develop/validate unsteady flamelet-generated-manifold models for concurrent flame spread against BASS imagery.

name: Computational and Experimental Analysis of SPICE Data Sets
title: Computational and Experimental Analysis of SPICE Data Sets
keywords: soot volume fraction; temperature; coflow flames; 1g vs 0g
objective: Derive temperature and soot volume fraction from 1600+ SPICE images and reconcile 1g vs 0g sooting.
